fields.name: Utah Electrical Training Alliance · Paid Electrician Apprenticeship
fields.description: Apply for paid electrical work with classroom training. Selection, fees and statewide travel make this a longer-term option.
fields.address: 7466 South Redwood Road, West Jordan, UT 84084

informationSections.programsAndServices: Paid electrical work with 8,000 hours of work training and 720 classroom hours. Apprentices pay for books and tuition.
informationSections.eligibilityRequirements: Age 18 or older; diploma or GED; passing algebra; valid driver’s license. Required records include identification, Social Security number, birth certificate and school records.
informationSections.howToBestConnect: Apply online and pay the $75 processing fee. Upload required documents within 30 days. Email apply@uteta.org for application help.
informationSections.access: Training center in West Jordan. Contractors may assign work anywhere in Utah, so reliable statewide travel is required.
informationSections.importantInformationToKnow: A complete application leads to an aptitude test; passing qualifies you for an interview. Interviews occur as needed. Applying does not promise admission or immediate paid work. Ask about total costs and the current wait before paying.
